summary: The United States employed a B-1 bomber against Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps targets for the first time in the current escalation cycle, marking a significant escalation in direct U.S. military involvement. President Trump publicly stated he is considering a massive attack on Iran larger than any previous operation, while a Likud MK indicated an Israeli strike may occur as early as this weekend. Israeli intelligence foiled an Iranian Intelligence Ministry plot to infiltrate a foreign operative cell into Israel targeting senior officials, even as a Palestinian Authority policeman carried out a stabbing attack in the northern West Bank.

Trump tells Israeli Channel 12 he is reviewing option of massive attack on Iran exceeding all previous operations. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/77444)
Likud MK Moshe Saada states Israel moving toward attack on Iran, possibly as soon as this weekend. (Source: @yediotnews25/133113)
Mossad and Shin Bet expose Iranian Intelligence Ministry network recruiting foreign proxies to infiltrate Israel and assassinate senior officials. (Source: @amitsegal/63302)
Widespread GPS/GNSS disruptions reported across Persian Gulf, Strait of Hormuz, southern Iran, UAE, Oman, Qatar, Iraq, and eastern Mediterranean. (Source: @kianmeli1/89987)
Palestinian Authority policeman from Tubas, 28, stabs IDF soldier in Ganim, Menashe Brigade; terrorist neutralized. (Source: @inon_yttach/9613, @yediotnews25/133119, @New_security8200/202895)
U.S. Senate rejects Trump Iran war powers resolution 49-47; House passes similar measure 214-208. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/77461, @presstv/200079)
Iran displays Zulfiqar ballistic missile in Tehran's Azadi Square; Iraqi PM affirms strategic partnership with Tehran. (Source: @naya_foriraq/85146, @SharghDaily/174012)
